title: Fix admin authorization check for product creation - Frontend debugging

requirements.summary: Add console logging in ProductManagement component to capture session token being sent with addProduct requests
acceptanceCriteria: Session token value is logged to browser console before making addProduct API call
Log output includes timestamp and token format for debugging

file_operations.description: Add console logging before the addProduct mutation call to log the session token value with timestamp. Include logging for: (1) the raw session token from useAuth store, (2) timestamp in ISO format, (3) token length and format validation. Wrap the addProduct mutation invocation to capture the exact payload being sent to the backend.

requirements.summary: Verify session token flow from useAuth through useQueries addProduct mutation to backend actor call
acceptanceCriteria: Session token from useAuth store is correctly included in the addProduct mutation payload
No token transformation or corruption occurs during the frontend-to-backend call chain

file_operations.description: Add console logging in the useAuth store to track session token state changes. Log when sessionToken is set, retrieved, or cleared. Include validation checks to ensure the token maintains its format throughout the store lifecycle.

Add detailed logging in the addProduct mutation to trace the session token through the mutation pipeline. Log: (1) session token received from useAuth at mutation invocation, (2) token before actor call, (3) any transformations applied to the token. Verify the token is correctly passed to the backend actor's addProduct method without modification.

Add comprehensive logging at the point where addProduct mutation is called to verify the complete data flow. Log the session token state immediately before mutation execution and verify it matches the expected format from useAuth store.
